verdict.rationale: CSC documents same-day scanning and delivery of SOP documents, time-stamped electronic delivery of searchable PDFs, and registered-agent coverage in all 50 states, DC, and international jurisdictions, so the same-day scan-and-deliver core is directly supported. The evidence never says SOP is accepted at a physical street office, and it describes delivery 'electronically' or by routing preferences rather than explicitly into the user's account. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of acceptance at a staffed physical street-address office, explicit confirmation that scanned SOP lands in the customer's CSCNavigator account, and independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day turnaround.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received
